name: push-guard
description: Claude Push Guard: stops a git push Claude runs when the commits would publish your name, email, home folder path or other words you list, and says exactly where they are.

words.title: Words to keep private
words.description: Comma-separated: your real name, personal email, company, anything that must not reach a public repo. Matched anywhere, any case.

protectGitIdentity.title: Protect your everyday git identity
protectGitIdentity.description: When the commits being pushed use a different name and email than your global git config, also block your global name and email (catches a real name leaking into a pseudonymous repo).

onlyPublic.title: Skip private GitHub repos
onlyPublic.description: Skip the check when the GitHub CLI can see the repo is private. Other hosts, and repos it cannot see, are always checked.

emDashes.title: Block em dashes
emDashes.description: Also block new lines and commit messages that contain an em dash.
